description: This file implements a store for managing persistent notifications related to posts in a Mattermost server, including retrieval, updating activity timestamps, and deletion based on various criteria.

classes.name: SqlPostPersistentNotificationStore
classes.description: A store for handling persistent notifications associated with posts, providing methods for retrieval, updates, and deletions.

methods.name: newSqlPostPersistentNotificationStore
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SqlPostPersistentNotificationStore with a given SqlStore.

methods.name: GetSingle
methods.description: Retrieves a single persistent notification post by postID.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of valid persistent notification posts based on provided parameters.

methods.name: UpdateLastActivity
methods.description: Updates the LastSentAt timestamp and SentCount for given post IDs.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Marks specified posts as deleted by setting DeleteAt timestamp.

methods.name: DeleteExpired
methods.description: Deletes notifications that have reached or exceeded a maximum sent count.

methods.name: DeleteByChannel
methods.description: Deletes notifications associated with specified channel IDs.

methods.name: DeleteByTeam
methods.description: Deletes notifications associated with specified team IDs.
